text: This was a very early report made with very limited information, very limited study, and
it merely represented the position that was being taken by one of the officers who had
been charged to write up the report.
And even though I didn't know this officer, if a person reads between the lines of the
report as I recall it. It could have been a posture simply to attract the attention
of the director of intelligence and chief of staff of the airport to the fact that this
could be a potentially serious problem. I don't know what the disposition of the report was. I
saw one file copy in the file that I'm here. I didn't know that.
